This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226
And 227 Of The Constitution Of India Praying To
i) Issue A Writ In The Nature Of Certiorari Quashing
The General Award No. Kiadb.Laq 2046/2023-24 Dated
06/06/2023 Passed By The 3Rd Respondent In Respect Of
The Petitioners Land Bearing Sy.No. 109/2, Measuring
2 Acre 39 Guntas, Situated At Doddagollahalli
Village, Kundana Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk Under
Section 29(3) Of Karnataka Industrial Areas
Development Act, 1966 (For Short Kiadb Act) As Per
Annexure-A And Etc.

THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard Sri. Punith C, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri. Yogesh D.Naik, learned AGA for the respondent No.1 and Sri.B.S.Sudhindra, learned counsel for the respondent Nos. 2 and 3.
2.

Present petition is seeking quash of the general award dated 06.06.2023 passed by the respondent No.3 NC: 2023:KHC:36947 as per Annexure-A in respect of land bearing Sy.No.109/2 measuring 2 acres 39 guntas of land situated at Doddagollahalli Village, Kundana Hobli,
Devanahalli Taluk and for a direction to the respondents to consider the case of the petitioners under Section 29(2) of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Act, 1966 (hereinafter referred to as 'Act; for short) for passing of the award on the basis of agreement.

3. Case of the petitioners is that land in Sy.No.109/2, measuring 2 acres 39 guntas referred to hereinabove originally belong to the father of the petitioners and upon his demise on 07.09.2009,
the children of deceased landlord (petitioners) had entered into a registered partition on 10.12.2013.
In the meanwhile, the aforesaid land was sought to be acquired by the respondents-authorities in terms of Final Notification dated 25.05.2022 and names of the petitioners have not been reflected in the notification as their names were not entered in the revenue records.
NC: 2023:KHC:36947 However, name of the father of the petitioners has been reflected.

He submits that though the petitioners are not opposing the acquisition, a general award has been passed as per Annexure-A while petitioners are ready and willing to accept compensation based on an agreement in terms of Section 29(2) of the KIAD Act.
Hence, the petition.

4. Learned counsel for the respondents submits that respondent-KIADB was constrained to pass general award in view of there being a pendency of the suit in O.S.No.1256/2006 pending on the file Smt. R. L. Uma vs State Of Karnataka on 10 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127302322/
3 of Civil Judge, Devanahalli, and that he fairly submits that if the petitioners now provided necessary details to the respondents-authority with regard to their title over the property, request of the petitioners for passing award on the basis of agreement under Section 29(2) of the Act would be considered.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that said suit in O.S.No.1256/2006 referred to above does not pertains to the petitioners in any manner whatsoever.
He NC: 2023:KHC:36947 submits that no suit or any dispute is pending with regard to title of the property.
6. Be that as it may.

In view of the submission made by the learned counsel for the respondents-KIADB, the general award dated 06.06.2023 passed by the respondent No.3 as per Annexure-A in respect of land bearing Sy.No.109/2 measuring 2 acres 39 guntas of land situated at Doddagollahalli Village, Kundana Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk is quashed and set aside.

The petitioners shall make representation in accordance with law within four (4) weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order seeking passing of compensation based on the agreement under Section 29(2) of KIAD Act.

The respondent Nos.2 and 3 is directed to consider the representation for award of compensation by way of agreement under Section 29(2) of the KIADB Act and pass necessary orders within a period of three (3) months from the date of receipt of representation of the petitioners.
The respondents-KIADB is at liberty to NC: 2023:KHC:36947 withdraw the amount that has been deposited before reference court pursuant to the general award passed by them.
Needless to state that in the event of any dispute, the general award would stand restored.
